method: Second intensive review of original source, raw facts and decoded literals; scanner scores were not verdict evidence.

samples.identification: Tr Wall 1.1.0 extension impersonating Trust Wallet
evidence: Persistent background entry polls navigator.clipboard.readText, suppresses unchanged values, slices text into randomized 700-1999 character chunks and sends each chunk in an encoded GET query.
Unicode escapes, reversed strings and constant XOR arithmetic conceal API names and URL parts. Decoded clipboard endpoint: http://185.99.97.59/continue.php.

Home page routes wallet creation, recovery and Ledger links to seed-phrase or private-key entry pages. Both load init.js, whose collectMetrics function spreads caller input into the JSON POST body for http://185.99.97.59/app.php.

Seed entry joins visible 12/18/24-word fields and calls the reporting callback after completion. Private-key entry reports typed input after a 1400ms debounce, before submission. Both Next handlers display invalid-input errors without wallet validation.
Manifest explicitly declares required data collection as none despite clipboard and wallet-secret exports.
execution_checks: Original background executed under QuickJS with clipboard, clocks, browser APIs and fetch mocked: 1960 characters became three GET requests with exact reassembly; repeated unchanged text was skipped.
Original init.js and private-key UI executed in a separate mocked document context: the exact key reached the JSON POST, and Next always displayed an error.
scope_limits: Browser permission or focus restrictions can make clipboard reads fail; the code swallows those errors. No attacker endpoint was contacted.
Embedded data URIs in HTML decode to WOFF2 fonts rather than executable script.

samples.identification: GitHub Actions workflow disguised as a security check
evidence: Push or manual dispatch runs curl -s -X POST with six repository secrets in one form body sent to http://193.32.204.199.
The workflow requests Python and npm publishing secrets, Docker Hub secrets, AWS secrets, and the VPS_SSH_KEY repository secret.
GitHub interpolates secrets before the shell executes, so the single quotes around the request body do not protect these values. The timestamp step only writes CACHE_BUST to GITHUB_ENV.

samples.identification: ProFTPD HELP-management module with a hidden shell command
evidence: With a populated help list and non-null target, the exact target ACIDBITCHEZ selects an added branch before normal command-help lookup.
The branch invokes setuid(0), setgid(0), and system("/bin/sh;/sbin/sh") without an authentication check in the handler or checks of identity-call success.
The shell list is sequential shell command text, not an HTTP semicolon path. The source does not establish a reverse connection or explicit socket-to-shell descriptor setup.
execution_checks: Compiled the unchanged source with a stub conf.h and intercepted setuid, setgid and system. The secret target produced exactly the three calls in order. Empty help list, ordinary HELP and wrong-case target did not trigger. No real privilege operation or shell launch occurred.

trait_decisions: Bind clipboard data through the same read, slice, array iteration, URL encoding and first fetch argument. First callback and fetch argument positions are semantic roles, not arbitrary identifiers.

Treat periodic clipboard export as suspicious; its contradiction of an explicit no-data-collection declaration establishes the hostile extension finding. Disclosed clipboard sync remains a negative control.
Retire the duplicate hostile HTTP-query rule that inferred theft from obfuscation and chunking without a sensitive source.
Move the XOR-array observation into arithmetic, require parsed numeric XOR elements, and remove an unsupported character-code/endpoint claim from that atom. Update its direct consumer.

Move literal-guarded setuid into process identity as a notable capability; use a parsed conditional rather than comments or raw string proximity. Backdoor composites require an actual shell launch within 256 bytes.
Distinguish command text consumed by system from exact image paths consumed by exec. A compound shell command is not an executable pathname.
Filter executable-directory command chains per matched semicolon string. A legitimate HTTP path elsewhere in the same file must remain visible.

Bind repeated Actions-secret interpolations to one quoted curl payload and anchor active curl command lines. One API credential, separate single-secret requests and commented commands are negative controls.

Relocate the exact dollar-separated decimal expression fragment from arithmetic to file encoding, preserving its matcher, platform/type scope and exact consumer. This correction also keeps the arithmetic leaf within its existing rule budget.

Relocate the existing extension-false-no-data-clipboard-exfil composite from extension deception into stealer/input as browser-clipboard-export-false-disclosure, retaining the clipboard permission and source/claim requirements. No exact or ancestor YAML consumers referenced its old home. This prevents duplicate hostile findings after repairing the source-bound export.

expectation_updates: Retarget the existing clipboard-disclosure fixture expectations to the relocated stealer/input trait, and require that exact trait on both hostile wallet-extension fixtures.
Remove a negative assertion for the already-retired dotnet-obfuscated-reflective-resource-payload ID from the legacy test list; the two active .NET resource-loader negative controls remain and pass.
